caption:
The video captures a tranquil lake set against a backdrop of jagged, snow-dusted mountains beneath a cloudless blue sky. A golden grassy hill slopes down the left side of the frame, its dry vegetation meeting the calm water's edge. The surface of the lake already carries a faint movement, with subtle ripples drifting steadily across it. These gentle undulations continuously warp the mirror image of the mountains and hills below.

On the right shoreline, a small white building nestles among a cluster of dark green trees. Its reflection, together with the bright snow patches of the peaks, shivers and elongates as the water shifts. The distortion never settles into a perfect mirror, nor does it grow violent; the ripple pattern simply reorganizes itself. The dry branches poking into the lower corners remain largely fixed against the moving water. Across the clip, the quiet landscape persists while the reflection keeps breathing with the lake's slow motion.
relations: Subtle ripples on the lake surface continuously warp and elongate the reflection of the mountains and golden hill.
The shifting water causes the reflection of the white building and trees to shiver and distort.
Fixed dry branches in the lower corners remain static while the moving water reorganizes the ripple pattern.
The static landscape persists, but the mirror image on the lake remains in a state of gentle, continuous distortion.
